meta.title: Vietnam's Heritage Train from Hue to Da Nang - An Unforgettable Journey
meta.description:
The Heritage Train from Hue to Da Nang is more than just a train ride. It's a chance to experience a different side of Vietnam aboard a beautifully restored vintage train, travelling along one of the country's most spectacular railway routes and crossing the famous Hai Van Pass.

Join Mina and me for the entire journey as we explore the train, take in the incredible coastal views, enjoy the onboard atmosphere and discover what makes this railway experience so special.

Sit back, relax and enjoy the Heritage Journey from Hue to Da Nang with us!

comments.author: @Ved-z2w
comments.text: Hey Andrei. Which Is this HD1 or HD3? Which seat number did you book?

comments.author: @euAndrei
comments.text:
It was the HD3 and while I had seat number 8, I wouldn’t necessarily recommend it as the window has a split across the center to open it.
The seats next to it have a full continuous window.

All seats along the window are a good choice, so you can’t really go wrong actually. Just ask for a window seat.

The other seat options are back towards the other side and more appropriate for a couple so you can sit together at a table, but you won’t have as clear a view, being further back from the window.
